template.name: Kaytranada
template.about: Bouncy swung house/hip-hop hybrid, filtered disco chops, warm sub, pumping bus.

project.name: Kaytranada
project.notes:
KAYTRANADA  (99.9%, Bubba; 2010s-today)

TECHNIQUE (sourced)
- "I'm using Maschine now. That with FruityLoops, but FruityLoops is pretty much for
  sampling"; started on FruityLoops at 14; "Swing recognize swing" (RBMA lecture).
- Specific synths and swing settings: unconfirmed.

THIS TEMPLATE
Swung drums at 60% (909/LinnDrum/CR-78-style channels; The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.), filtered disco chops (built-in
low-pass at 1.8 kHz), rubber synth bass, EP chords, a hard slow-release compressor on the
Music Bus for the bounce.

MIX NOTES
- Kick and bass interlock. The Music Bus compressor pumps on the bus's own peaks; for a true
  kick side-chain, ride the bus level by hand or with automation.
- Master: built-in glue, Lemon Limiter; -9 to -8 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Good. No Maschine: the rack plus the Sampler covers the workflow. No side-chain input on the
built-in compressor; the drums are synthesized one-shots, not samples of the machines.

SOURCES
RBMA lecture "Kaytranada"; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 112 BPM, 4/4, key Fmin, cycle bars 1-8.

Tracks
- Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (909) = kick-909.wav, Clap (909) = clap.wav, Rim (909) = rim.wav, Hat (LinnDrum) = hat-acoustic.wav, Open Hat (909) = openhat-909.wav, Shaker (CR-78) = shaker.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 80, Make-up 2)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (14 steps on), swing 60% (MPC terms), 6 rows = the rack's channels
- Disco Chops (filtered) (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Sampler (SP-303 model): effect FilterDrive on, CTRL 1-3 = 50%, 35%, 20%; quantize 16; pad grade standard
    strip FX: Filter (Cutoff 1800, Resonance 1.5, low-pass)
- Sub / Synth Bass (Instrument, -5 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Basses/Rubber Bass"
- Chords (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Keys/E. Piano 4 Chorus"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -16 dB
- Lead Vocal (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -20, Ratio 4, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 3)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -18 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -20 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Compressor (Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 100, Make-up 3)
- Music Bus (bus 2): Compressor (Threshold -26, Ratio 6, Attack 1, Release 250, Make-up 4)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): Compressor (Release 150, Make-up 2)
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 0.6, Decay Curve 1, IR "00.5s Small Room")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 803.6, Tone 4500, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 2, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Lemon Limiter: gain +3.5 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
